json.note: API first, then UI and tests in parallel.

tasks.title: Add GET /items endpoint
tasks.spec: Add a GET /items handler in internal/api that lists items from the store as JSON, ordered by id.
acceptance_criteria: GET /items returns 200 with a JSON array
an integration test covers the empty and non-empty store

tasks.title: Show items in the web list view
tasks.spec: Render the items returned by GET /items in web/app/items/page.tsx as a table with id and name.
acceptance_criteria: the items page shows every item from the API
a component test checks the empty state

tasks.title: End-to-end test for item listing
tasks.spec: Write an end-to-end test that creates two items through the API and checks GET /items returns both in order.
acceptance_criteria: the e2e test fails before the api task and passes after it
the test runs in CI with make test
